about.title: About this data
about.zones: Rolling ranges use UTC days; hourly buckets are UTC hours shown in the time zone from Settings (browser default). Today, This week and This month are absolute calendar windows in that time zone (weeks start Monday), built by folding hourly buckets into local days; days older than retained hourly history fall back to UTC daily buckets.
about.restarts: Counters that go backwards (an engine restart) are re-seeded from the new value, so a restart never inflates totals. Tokens served right before a restart can be missed.
about.retention: Hourly history is kept for {{hours}} hours and daily history for {{days}} days. The hourly view only has data from when it was first recorded.
about.allTime: All time is the lifetime total since tracking began; its chart shows the retained daily buckets.
about.allTimeUnavailable: All time is the retained daily total right now (the lifetime endpoint is unavailable); its chart shows the retained daily buckets.
about.vocabulary: Generated = tokens the model wrote. Prompt = tokens it read. Cached prefill is the part of the prompt served from the prefix cache; computed prefill is the observed uncached part. Missing cache counters remain unknown. Cache hit rate uses only input tokens with an observed cache split; partial coverage is shown explicitly. Local SGLang log counts measure scheduled prefill work, including retries, rather than completed-request billing.
about.noComparison: No change-versus-previous figures are shown because {{period}} was not fully tracked.
